arxiv-2107-13572.title: Sign-Problem-Free Variant of Complex Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Model
arxiv-2107-13572.creator: Byungmin Kang, Junggi Yoon
arxiv-2107-13572.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Byungmin Kang, Junggi Yoon. We construct a sign-problem free variant of the complex Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model which keeps all the essential properties of the SYK model, including the analytic solvability in the large- N N limit and being maximally chaotic.

arxiv-2201-09040.title: Optimal Estimation and Computational Limit of Low-rank Gaussian Mixtures
arxiv-2201-09040.creator: Zhongyuan Lyu, Dong Xia
arxiv-2201-09040.description: Abstract Structural matrix-variate observations routinely arise in diverse fields such as multi-layer network analysis and brain image clustering. While data of this type have been extensively investigated with fruitful outcomes being delivered, the fundamental questions like its statistical optimality and computational limit are largely under-explored.

arxiv-2202-13541.title: Pattern Based Multivariable Regression using Deep Learning (PBMR-DP) CVPR Proceedings
arxiv-2202-13541.creator: Jiztom Kavalakkatt Francis, Chandan Kumar, Jansel Herrera-Gerena, Kundan Kumar, Matthew J Darr
arxiv-2202-13541.description: Abstract We propose a deep learning methodology for multivariable regression that is based on pattern recognition that triggers fast learning over sensor data. We used a conversion of sensors-to-image which enables us to take advantage of Computer Vision architectures and training processes.

arxiv-2205-05620.title: Wigner molecules and hybrid qubits
arxiv-2205-05620.creator: Constantine Yannouleas & Uzi Landman
arxiv-2205-05620.description: Abstract It is demonstrated that exact diagonalization of the microscopic many-body Hamiltonian via systematic full configuration-interaction (FCI) calculations is able to predict the spectra as a function of detuning of three-electron hybrid qubits based on GaAs asymmetric double quantum dots.

arxiv-2504-04917.title: Modeling the circumstellar interaction around SN 2004gq
arxiv-2504-04917.creator: A. P. Nagy, B. H. Pál, T. Szalai
arxiv-2504-04917.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by A. P. Nagy, B. H. Pál, T. Szalai. The relationship between the mass-loss history and final evolutionary stage of massive stars and the properties of the observable supernova (SN) is still under debate. This is especially true for stripped-envelope (Type Ib/c) SNe, where the progenitor ejects a considerably large amount of material during its evolution, which can lead to a circumstellar medium relatively close to the exploding star.

arxiv-2510-05935.title: LLM-FS-Agent: A Deliberative Role-based Large Language Model Architecture for Transparent Feature Selection
arxiv-2510-05935.creator: Bal-Ghaoui Mohamed, Sabri Fayssal
arxiv-2510-05935.description: Abstract The pervasive challenge of high-dimensional data in Machine Learning pipelines often compromises model interpretability and efficiency. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown potential in Dimensionality Reduction (RD) through Feature Selection (FS), existing LLM-based approaches often lack structured reasoning and transparent justification for their decisions.

pmc-11442061.title: Explicating the multifunctional roles of tocotrienol and squalene in promoting skin health
pmc-11442061.creator: Nevvin Raaj Morgan, Kasthuri Bai Magalingam, Ammu Kutty Radhakrishnan, Mohan Arumugam, Adawiyah Jamil, Saatheeyavaane Bhuvanendran
pmc-11442061.description: The skin is the largest organ in the integumentary system, protecting against various external threats, including ultraviolet exposure, heat, infections, dehydration and mechanical injuries. Skin disorders can arise from various causes, including allergic reactions or breaches in the skin barrier, which allow microorganisms or chemicals to penetrate the sweat ducts.

pmc-11527395.title: A Systematic Review of Comparative Effectiveness of Interventions for Low Anterior Resection Syndrome: Impacts on Bowel Function and Quality of Life
pmc-11527395.creator: Mehwish Ansar, Sruthi Boddeti, Khutaija Noor, Aparna Malireddi, Mahlet Abera, Suchith B Suresh, Iana Malasevskaia
pmc-11527395.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Low anterior resection syndrome (LARS) is a common complication following sphincter-preserving surgical resection for rectal cancer, characterized by symptoms such as fecal incontinence, urgency, and altered bowel habits, which significantly affect patients' quality of life. This cluster of symptoms not only limits their day-to-day physical activity but also has a debilitating effect on their emotional and mental well-being, undermining their integration and overall psychological health.

pmc-11605062.title: The DNA-based Lassa vaccine INO-4500 confers durable protective efficacy in cynomolgus macaques against lethal Lassa fever
pmc-11605062.creator: Viviane M. Andrade, Kathleen Cashman, Kyle Rosenke, Eric Wilkinson, Nicole Josleyn, Ginger Lynn, Jesse Steffens, Sean Vantongeren, Jay Wells, Connie Schmaljohn, Paul Facemire, Jingjing Jiang, Jean Boyer, Aditya Patel, Friederike Feldmann, Patrick Hanley, Jamie Lovaglio, Kimberly White, Heinz Feldman
pmc-11605062.description: BackgroundWe have previously developed a DNA-based vaccine, INO-4500, encoding the Lassa lineage IV glycoprotein precursor. INO-4500, when delivered with electroporation, elicited humoral and cellular responses, and conferred 100% protection in cynomolgus non-human primates. Here, we expanded the characterization of INO-4500 assessing immunogenicity and protective efficacy of lower doses and single immunization, and the durability of immune responses.

pmc-12596154.title: Acute nicotine poisoning in a 2-year-old child - A case report of a near-death event
pmc-12596154.creator: Mohd Shaiful Ehsan Shalihin, Sakinah Md Rifin, Nur Izzati Binti Mohd Sabri
pmc-12596154.description: Acute nicotine poisoning is a devastating condition that occurs when there is an excessive intake of nicotine, a toxic alkaloid found in tobacco products, mainly e-cigarettes. It impairs respiratory and neurological functioning due to its massive inflammatory effect. It is mainly related to vaping activity. Most smokers know about smoking’s adverse effects and implications.

pmc-13567559.title: Green Analytical Workflows: Recent Advances in Sample Preparation and Instrumental Analysis of Food Contact Materials
pmc-13567559.creator: Lorenzo Cortesi, Nicolò Riboni, Clarissa Facchini, Federica Bianchi
pmc-13567559.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Food contact materials (FCMs) represent a major route of exposure to chemicals since they can migrate from packaging into food, raising health concerns. Due to its heterogeneous nature and complexity, the monitoring of chemicals present in or released by FCMs poses a significant analytical challenge, requiring both target methods for the quantitative determination of both intentionally and non-intentionally added substances (IAS and NIAS) and untargeted approaches to fingerprint the material and identify previously unknown IAS and NIAS.
